description: This file defines a Java interface named DigitalProductDao, which extends a generic DAO interface for managing DigitalProduct entities. It declares a method to retrieve a DigitalProduct based on a product and merchant store.

classes.name: DigitalProductDao
classes.description: A Data Access Object interface for DigitalProduct entities, providing method signatures for database interactions related to digital products.

methods.name: getByProduct
methods.description: Retrieves a DigitalProduct associated with a specific product and merchant store.
